integrity: Stationary flux normalization, explicit reflection sufficiency, three-jump combinatorial necessity and cubic KL order-counting are demonstrated analytically. Standalone exact-rational and semigroup-based tests are supplementary, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the strictly directed four-state ring with deterministic alternating parity readout is classified. Nonzero four-frame detection is guaranteed only for sufficiently fine uniformly spaced samples. Microscopic reverse path probability vanishes, so the measured KL is finite observed-block information, not microscopic thermodynamic heat dissipation. Publication priority and broader hidden-Markov coverage remain uncertain.
title: Binary observations of a directed four-state cycle: exact reversibility boundary and cubic four-frame information
